business_problem: Accuris oversees one of the world’s most extensive catalogs of electronic components, each component is enriched with structured and unstructured data such as parametric data, environmental attributes, pricing and supporting documentation. This data’s sheer volume and variety made it challenging to generate AI-ready insights at scale.
solution_summary: Accuris built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Delta Lake, Lakeflow Jobs, Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines. Accuris oversees one of the world’s most extensive catalogs of electronic components, each component is enriched with structured and unstructured data such as parametric data, environmental attributes, pricing and supporting documentation. This data’s sheer volume and variety made it challenging to generate AI-ready insights at scale. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines builds transformation pipelines over shared data with Spark-based processing.
